_doc: Egress-proxy injection rules. Each ruled host is MITM-terminated (leaf cert signed by the local CA the caller trusts); the real secret is pulled from your broker and injected on the wire, so the calling tool only ever holds a placeholder. Non-ruled hosts blind-tunnel untouched. Copy to egress_rules.json. inject_location = header|query|path. value_template lets an auth scheme prefix the secret, e.g. 'Bearer {value}'. Not enrollable: HMAC-signed APIs whose signature depends on the request body + nonce + secret (a static-value proxy cannot compute the signature).
